'''Shungbeek''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that pupated at some point in their lifetime. They breathed an [[argon]]-rich [[atmosphere]], and had to wear an enclosed [[perspex]] dome to survive in other conditions. [[Kid Malmash]] was a young Shungbeek who worked as a [[pilot]], transporting refugees to safe destinations.<ref name="TROS VD" />
